title: 第12章  可愿留在灵药峰
content_zh:
半个时辰后，近百株银龙草便整整齐齐的种植在空地上。
通常情况下，银龙草种植下去之后会先萎靡一阵，能否存活，需要过上一个时辰才能看出。
而苏烬生二人种下的银龙草闪烁光芒，熠熠生辉，全然没有半点枯败的迹象！
仅一眼便可看出，生机勃勃之状！
真，真的能全部移植活！
张长老圆瞪双目，死死的盯着那片被移植活的银龙草，心中万分震惊。
与灵药打了近百年交道了，却从来没有见过这般惊人的存活率！
这二人简直就是种植灵药的宝体啊！
“咳咳！”
“苏烬生，林月舒，你们二人可愿留在灵药峰，看管这些灵药？”
张长老目光转移间，看向二人，直接了当出声。
如此宝体，他肯定不能放过！
林月舒略微吃惊，眼中满是诧异之色，她知道，灵药峰看管严格，一般弟子无事不得进入其中。
就算是现在，整个灵药峰也不过只有张长老和廉妄言二人而已。
如今，竟然开口让她们两个留在灵药峰？
她心中虽然有些激动，但还是将目光看向苏烬生，听从苏烬生的吩咐。
苏烬生对此要求则是并不意外，在他刚才种植灵药的时候就已经想到了这一层。
毕竟，他们两个种植的灵药可以减少一切损失，全部存活。
这种惊人的能力，放在任何地方，都是宝贝一样的存在。
更何况，张长老还是炼药师，又怎会让他们继续去当杂役弟子？

苏烬生看了一眼林月舒，看出她也想要留在此地，便直接回答道。
“弟子二人愿意留在灵药峰，多谢张长老！”
留在灵药峰，对他来说有利而无害。
其一便是脱离杂役弟子身份，日后便可以不受杂役总管管辖，避免落入其埋伏的陷阱之中。
其二，这灵药峰的灵气浓郁，在这里修炼绝对事半功倍。
其三，灵药峰弟子身份可以保护他们，至少一些屑小之辈不敢与他们动手。
毕竟，整个宗门上下，灵药峰弟子是最受尊敬的。
因为所有弟子每个月所灵气的修炼资源，凝气丹等丹药，都是出自灵药峰。
虽然不是他们炼制的，但与他们也脱不了干系。
“好！好！好！”
张长老难掩激动神色，一连说出三个好字，脸上笑容根本遮掩不住！
“师傅，灵药种植好了！”
这个时候，廉妄言也种植好了五十株银龙草，一瘸一拐的走了过来，言语不清晰道。
即便过去了半个多时辰，他脸上的臃肿还未曾消下去，依旧如同猪头一般！
再看那种植的五十株银龙草，只有三两株银龙草带有几分生机，其余的都是气息微眯，神色黯淡，一副即将枯死之状。
这一次种植灵药的存活率，十不存一！
只不过，廉妄言境界低下，无法察觉到这微妙的变化。
但张长老可是与这些灵药打了上百年交道了，仅一眼便看出有几株存活。
当即，脸上的笑容消失，面色阴沉无比，双眸宛若两团烈焰燃烧一般，怒气冲冲！
“看你种植的银龙草，一成存活率都没有，还敢说刚才那片银龙草是你种植的？”

声音低沉，带有强悍的压迫席卷而去，手掌翻转间，一道强悍攻势便已奔袭而去。
“咔嚓！！”
只听骨裂的声音响起，廉妄言另一条腿也被打断，直接倒在了地上。
剧烈的疼痛让他面部扭曲，遍地打滚。
“自今日起，你便不再是我弟子，收拾东西，滚下山去吧！”
张长老言语凌厉，声音坚定，没有半点商讨的余地！
廉妄言强忍疼痛，凶狠的目光看向远处，当看到那生机勃勃的银龙草之时。
心中无比震惊，这两人，究竟是什么怪物！
竟，竟然真的能全部移植活，这简直太不可思议了！
再看师傅那决绝的神色，他知道，事情已经到了无法挽回的余地了。
只能撑着身子朝着山峰下爬去，每爬出一分，心中恨意就浓郁一分。
他发誓，一定要让苏烬生付出代价，以报今日之仇恨！
苏烬生和林月舒则是神色平静的看着那道爬行身影，心中无半点怜悯。
毕竟，这一切都是廉妄言自找的，与他们没有半点关系！
“这两个令牌你们拿着，现在就回去收拾东西，直接搬到灵药峰居住！”
张长老脸上怒色消散，取而代之的是一脸笑容，同时拿出两块令牌，开口出声道。
“若是杂役总管敢阻拦你们，直接亮出令牌即可，晾他也不敢如何！”
苏烬生接过令牌，递给了林月舒一块，而后开口道。
“知道了长老！”
随即，便带着林月舒迈步朝着山下走去，嘴角处，一抹弧度悄然勾起。

真没有想到，杂役总管本想借此来报复他们，却弄巧成拙，无形中帮了他们。
真想看到杂役总管知道后那副气急败坏的样子。
下山途中，还看到了廉妄言那狼狈的身影，并未言语，只是用藐视扫视了一眼。
仅这一眼，就让廉妄言备受屈辱，双手紧握成拳，心中恨意滔天。
双眸中满是血丝，绽放杀意！
苏烬生自然察觉到了这浓郁杀意，但并未理会，毕竟，贸然斩杀同门弟子，是需要受到处罚的。
为了一条蝼蚁的性命，而把自己搭进去，不值得！
反正自己的实力比之强出数倍，日后差距也会越来越大，若廉妄言真要自寻死路。
那他便不介意送上一程！
两刻钟后，苏烬生和林月舒各自回到住处，开始收拾起了东西。
实际上，苏烬生并没有什么东西要收拾的，平常所用之物都在储物戒指中。
这次主要是陪同林月舒一起回来，再顺带摆脱杂役弟子的身份罢了。
虽然加入灵药峰后做的还是看护灵药这些杂活，但身份已经截然不同。
非杂役总管能够管辖的！
谁知，苏烬生刚刚回到住处，杂役总管便听闻风声，紧跟了过来。
content_en:
Half an hour later, nearly a hundred Silver Dragon Grass plants were neatly planted in the open space.
Under normal circumstances, the Silver Dragon Grass will wilt for a while after being planted. It will take an hour to see whether it can survive.
And the silver dragon grass planted by Su Jinsheng and his wife shone brightly, showing no signs of decay at all!
You can tell at just one glance that it is full of vitality!
Really, really all of them can survive transplantation!
Elder Zhang stared at the piece of transplanted Silver Dragon Grass with wide eyes, feeling extremely shocked.
I have been dealing with elixirs for nearly a hundred years, but I have never seen such an astonishing survival rate!
These two people are simply treasures for cultivating elixirs!
"Ahem!"
"Su Jinsheng, Lin Yueshu, are you two willing to stay at the elixir peak and take care of these elixirs?"
Elder Zhang shifted his gaze, looked at the two of them, and spoke directly.
He definitely can't let go of such a precious body!
Lin Yueshu was slightly surprised, her eyes full of surprise. She knew that Spiritual Medicine Peak was strictly guarded and ordinary disciples were not allowed to enter it without any incident.
Even now, there are only two people in the entire Spirit Medicine Peak: Elder Zhang and Lian Wangyan.
Now, he actually asked them to stay at Spiritual Medicine Peak?
Although she was a little excited, she still looked at Su Jinsheng and followed Su Jinsheng's instructions.
Su Jinsheng was not surprised by this request. He had already thought of this when he planted the elixir just now.
After all, the elixir planted by the two of them can reduce all losses and keep everyone alive.
This amazing ability is like a treasure wherever you place it.
What's more, Elder Zhang is still an alchemist, so how can he let them continue to be servant disciples?
Su Jinsheng glanced at Lin Yueshu and saw that she also wanted to stay here, so he answered directly.
"The two disciples are willing to stay at Spiritual Medicine Peak. Thank you very much, Elder Zhang!"
Staying at Spiritual Medicine Peak would be beneficial but not harmful to him.
One is to break away from the status of a handyman disciple, so that in the future, he will be free from the jurisdiction of the handyman in chief and avoid falling into his ambush trap.
Secondly, the spiritual energy of this elixir peak is rich, and practicing here will definitely get twice the result with half the effort.
Thirdly, their status as disciples of the Spiritual Medicine Peak can protect them, at least some of the lesser people dare not make a move against them.
After all, the disciples of Spiritual Medicine Peak are the most respected in the entire sect.
Because the spiritual energy cultivation resources, Qi Condensation Pills and other elixirs that all disciples receive each month come from the Spiritual Medicine Peak.
Although it was not refined by them, it is inseparable from them.
"Okay! Okay! Okay!"
Elder Zhang couldn't hide his excitement. He said three good words in a row and couldn't hide the smile on his face!
"Master, the elixir has been planted!"
At this time, Lian Huanyan also planted fifty Silver Dragon Grass plants and limped over, speaking unclearly.
Even though more than half an hour had passed, the bloating on his face had not gone away, and he was still as big as a pig's head!
Looking at the fifty Silver Dragon Grass plants, only three or two Silver Dragon Grass plants had some vitality, while the rest had slightly narrowed auras and gloomy expressions, as if they were about to die.
The survival rate of planting the elixir this time is 1 out of 10!
However, Lian Wuyan's realm was too low to notice this subtle change.
But Elder Zhang has been dealing with these elixirs for hundreds of years, and he can tell at a glance how many are still alive.
Immediately, the smile on his face disappeared, his face became extremely gloomy, and his eyes were like two balls of flames burning with anger!
"Looking at the silver dragon grass you planted, the survival rate is not even 10%. How dare you say that you planted the silver dragon grass just now?"
The voice was low, with strong oppression sweeping away, and as soon as the palm of the hand was turned, a powerful offensive rushed away.
"Crack!!"
Hearing the sound of bone cracking, Lian Wangyan's other leg was also broken and he fell directly to the ground.
The severe pain caused his face to twist and he was rolling around.
"From today on, you will no longerYou are my disciple, pack your things and get down the mountain! "
Elder Zhang’s words were sharp and his voice was firm, leaving no room for discussion!
Lian Wangyan endured the pain and looked fiercely into the distance, when he saw the vibrant Silver Dragon Grass.
I was extremely shocked, what kind of monsters were these two people!
Actually, all of them can be transplanted and survive. This is simply unbelievable!
Looking at the master's determined expression, he knew that the matter had reached an point of no return.
I can only hold my body and climb towards the bottom of the mountain. Every time I climb out, the hatred in my heart becomes stronger.
He vowed to make Su Jinsheng pay the price to repay today's hatred!
Su Jinsheng and Lin Yueshu looked at the crawling figure with calm expressions, without any pity in their hearts.
After all, all of this was caused by Lian's lies and had nothing to do with them!
"You take these two tokens, go back and pack your things now, and move directly to the Spiritual Medicine Peak! "
The anger on Elder Zhang's face disappeared and was replaced by a smile. He took out two tokens at the same time and spoke.
"If the handyman manager dares to stop you, just show your token, and you won't dare to do anything to him! "
Su Jinsheng took the token, handed one to Lin Yueshu, and then said.
"I know, elder! "
Immediately, he took Lin Yueshu and walked down the mountain, with a slight arc at the corner of his mouth.
I really didn't expect that the general manager of the handyman wanted to use this to take revenge on them, but he ended up self-defeating and helped them invisibly.
I really want to see the furious look on the face of the head clerk when he finds out.
On the way down the mountain, I also saw Lian Wangyan's embarrassed figure. He didn't say anything, but just glanced at him with contempt.
Just this look made Lian Wangyan feel humiliated, his hands clenched into fists, and the hatred in his heart was overwhelming.
His eyes were bloodshot and filled with murderous intent!
Su Jinsheng was naturally aware of the strong murderous intent, but ignored it. After all, rashly killing fellow disciples would require punishment.
It's not worth risking yourself for the life of an ant!
Anyway, his strength is several times stronger than hers, and the gap will get bigger and bigger in the future. Ruo Lian's lies will really lead to his own death.
Then he wouldn't mind giving him a ride!
Two quarters of an hour later, Su Jinsheng and Lin Yueshu returned to their residences and began to pack their things.
In fact, Su Jinsheng didn't have anything to pack, and the things he usually used were all in the storage ring.
This time, the main purpose was to accompany Lin Yueshu back and get rid of his status as a handyman disciple.
Although he still did chores like taking care of elixirs after joining the elixir peak, his identity was completely different.
It is beyond the jurisdiction of the general manager!
Unexpectedly, as soon as Su Jinsheng returned to his residence, the handyman manager heard the news and followed him closely.
